resources.string: Find StudyBuddy in this list and turn the permission on, then come back.
Turn on “Allow notifications”, then return to StudyBuddy.
Switch on “Allow setting alarms and reminders”, then return to StudyBuddy.
Tap StudyBuddy, then switch “Permit usage access” on.
Tap StudyBuddy, then switch “Allow display over other apps” on.
Open Installed apps or Downloaded services, tap StudyGuard, then switch “Use StudyGuard” on and confirm.
Find StudyBuddy in this list and switch “Allow Do Not Disturb” on.
Choose “All apps”, tap StudyBuddy, then pick “Don’t optimise” so long sessions are not paused.
Pick StudyBuddy as the home app. You can switch back to your usual launcher here at any time.
